#!/bin/bash

# Open Chrome with google.com
google-chrome "https://www.google.com" &

# Open a text editor (using nano, or fall back to vim if nano not available)
if command -v nano &> /dev/null; then
    nano &
elif command -v vim &> /dev/null; then
    vim &
elif command -v gedit &> /dev/null; then
    gedit &
else
    echo "No text editor found!"
    exit 1
fi

# Open file manager showing [private-home]/Documents/llama.cpp
if command -v nautilus &> /dev/null; then
    nautilus [private-home]/Documents/llama.cpp &
elif command -v thunar &> /dev/null; then
    thunar [private-home]/Documents/llama.cpp &
elif command -v dolphin &> /dev/null; then
    dolphin [private-home]/Documents/llama.cpp &
else
    echo "No file manager found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "All applications opened successfully."
